summary: Max Verstappen arrives at the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia with Red Bull's revolutionary upgrade package fully operational, securing pole position and establishing himself as the clear favorite despite Lewis Hamilton's championship ambitions. George Russell and Charles Leclerc both acknowledge Red Bull's dominance in Friday practice, but Ferrari's pace suggests the Scuderia could mount a credible challenge in the sweltering Malaysian heat that will test both machinery and driver endurance. A victory for Verstappen would extend his championship cushion significantly, while a Ferrari triumph or surprising result from Mercedes could reshape the 2026 title fight heading into the season's final stretch.
